bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,subprocess,sys
q="""SELECT m.chat_id,p.message_thread_id,m.message_id FROM startless_public_post_migrations m JOIN topic_dm_entry_pins p ON p.chat_id=m.chat_id AND p.message_id=m.message_id WHERE m.state='uncertain' AND NOT (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM posting_topics t WHERE t.chat_id=p.chat_id AND t.message_thread_id=p.message_thread_id AND t.purpose='link') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM board_menu_panels b WHERE b.chat_id=p.chat_id AND b.message_thread_id=p.message_thread_id AND b.panel_type='general_guide') OR p.title ILIKE '%総合案内%' OR p.title ILIKE '%コミュニテーリング%' OR p.title ILIKE '%相互リング%' OR p.title ILIKE '%ﾘﾝｸ%' OR p.title ILIKE '%コミュニティリンク%') ORDER BY m.chat_id,m.message_id"""
r=subprocess.run(["docker","exec","deploy-postgres-1","psql","-X","-v","ON_ERROR_STOP=1","-U","gace","-d","gaybbs","-At","-F","|","-c",q],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
if r.returncode:sys.exit(61)
entries=[tuple(map(int,line.split("|"))) for line in r.stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]
if len(entries)!=5:sys.exit(62)

 p=subprocess.run(["python3","scripts/userbot_topic_audit_client.py","--chat-id",str(chat),"--topic-id",str(thread)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=125)
 if p.returncode:sys.exit(63)
 docs=[json.loads(v.split("=",1)[1]) for v in p.stdout.splitlines() if v.startswith("USERBOT_TOPIC_AUDIT=")]
 rows=[v for v in docs[0]["rows"] if v["topic_id"]==thread] if len(docs)==1 else []
 if len(rows)!=1 or rows[0].get("migration",{}).get("transport")!="NOT_FOUND":sys.exit(64)
 if rows[0]["post_button"]=="ABSENT":mask|=1<<i
 elif rows[0]["post_button"]!="PRESENT":sys.exit(65)
print("ABSENT_TARGET_INDEX_MASK="+str(mask))
sys.exit(100+mask)
